description: This file defines a Java interface named MerchantConfigurationDao, which extends a generic DAO interface and declares methods for accessing merchant configuration data. It includes method signatures for retrieving configurations based on key, store, and type.

classes.name: MerchantConfigurationDao
classes.description: A DAO interface for handling merchant configuration data, providing methods to retrieve configuration entities based on keys, store, and type.

methods.name: getMerchantConfiguration
methods.description: Retrieves a single MerchantConfiguration based on a key and store.

methods.name: getMerchantConfigurations
methods.description: Retrieves a list of MerchantConfiguration objects associated with a specific store.

methods.name: listByType
methods.description: Retrieves a list of MerchantConfiguration objects filtered by configuration type and store.
